target_context.staging_policy: Evaluate external or unapproved content in a recoverable staging boundary before project-wide integration.
target_context.content_root_policy: Keep source packages, project adaptations, generated outputs, and production-approved content distinguishable.

asset_demands.name: Primary structural architecture family
asset_demands.production_function: Carry the approved silhouette, frontage rhythm, entrances, roof hierarchy, and ordinary repeated buildings.
asset_demands.scale_range: Derive from the approved plan and runtime-camera evidence.
required_capabilities: Readable at the approved runtime-camera distance
Supports hero and ordinary repetition without changing the typology
visual_constraints: Preserve the approved roof and frontage hierarchy
Do not introduce a fortress-like silhouette
technical_constraints: Compatible with the declared engine, platform, rendering, collision, and performance context
Dependencies and required plugins must be declared
hard_exclusions: Missing reverse sides in reachable views
No viable foundation or slope-contact solution
acceptance_evidence: Performance and cook evidence before production approval

sourcing_strategy.fallback: Evaluate an ownership-confirmed library family, custom transitions, or reopen the concept and Area Composition Plan.

candidates.title: Existing project architecture kit candidate
candidates.provenance: Existing project content; verify owner, source, adaptations, and dependencies.

license.intended_scope: Use only within the declared project until provenance review says otherwise.

integration_risks: Exact dependency and required-plugin inventory is pending.

total_cost.storage_and_source_control: Measure exact selected package and derived-data impact.
total_cost.shader_and_derived_data: Measure representative compile and cache impact.

demand_coverage.gap_reason: Family completeness, compatibility, representative visual fit, and production cost remain unverified.
demand_coverage.fallback: Search ownership-confirmed libraries, author missing transitions, or reopen the concept and plan.

acquisition_actions.rollback: Keep the candidate unmodified and outside production placement until representative approval.

blocked_reasons: Replace template placeholders and confirm the complete demand registry, owners, budget boundaries, due stages, and fallbacks.
asset_plan_ready.rollback_target: Approved Stage 2a contract and unmodified project inventory baseline.

blocked_reasons: The selected candidate is not REPRESENTATIVE_APPROVED.
visual_slice_ready.rollback_target: Last accepted playable blockout and unstaged candidate baseline.

blocked_reasons: The production demand and selected candidate are not production-ready.
production_dressing_ready.rollback_target: Last accepted Visual Feasibility Slice and production content baseline.
